$comment: Advisories we knowingly accept. Each needs a reason and an expiry; scripts/audit.ts fails once it lapses.

accepted.reason: Build-time only: @expo/cli validates app.json with it. Not in the app bundle, no untrusted input reaches it. No patched zod 3.x exists; npm's only fix is downgrading to Expo SDK 51.

Runtime, in URL parsing: a crafted link to the app could hang that tab (DoS, single user, no data exposure). Tested 2026-11-12: the fix (0.5.1) is ESM-only with a default export, while query-string 7 require()s it and calls it as a function, so an override would crash routing. Waits for an expo-router that drops query-string 7; re-check at the next SDK upgrade.
Build-time only: merges our own app.json config. No untrusted input reaches it, no fixed release exists.

Same exposure as GHSA-vcc3-ghjq-m6fr: a crafted URL could hang that tab or the app (DoS, single user, no data exposure). The only fix is the Expo SDK 58 upgrade (expo-router 58 no longer uses it); planned right after the curriculum work. Short expiry on purpose.
